release_name: Live TV v5.1.6 — Fixed Remote Layout & Zero-Overlap Tactile D-Pad
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🎮 Fixed Remote Layout & Zero-Overlap D-Pad: Re-engineered stepper clusters with 108px explicit box bounds and proportional center buttons (Quality & Mute), completely eliminating D-Pad collision and overlap
📺 Active Mac TV Status Header: Added a sleek, live status capsule at the top of the remote showing the currently playing channel and instant play/pause toggle
🎯 Precision Tactile D-Pad: Styled with high-contrast hardware radial finish, clear directional arrows, and 56px center Play/Pause disc with 14px safety clearance
📱 100% Zero-Scroll Viewport: Perfect vertical balance across all mobile screens with 0px horizontal or vertical scroll
🛡️ 100% Ad-Free Live TV (Zero-Ad Shield): Zero commercial interruptions across all 2,989 channels
